{{Top|leg}}
'''Neural links''' were technology that could connect an organic [[Brain/Legends|brain]] to electronics. The brains implanted in [[Shadow Droid]]s were connected to the internal systems of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] via a neural link.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
